title: Posterior filtering versus prior-only rollout
purpose: Keep observation-corrected filtering error separate from prior-only rollout error in a partially observed action-conditioned state-space fixture.
allowed_claims: The fixed seeded fixture has higher prior-only open-loop RMSE than observation-corrected filtering RMSE.
Filtering, open-loop, and persistence measurements use the same generated trajectory.
forbidden_claims: The fixture is a trained neural RSSM or reproduces PlaNet or Dreamer.
The fixture estimates population performance, training convergence, GPU use, planning utility, or deployment safety.
Low filtering error proves that prior-only imagined rollouts are accurate.

datasets.name: procedural 1D partially observed trajectory
datasets.split_definition: One 32-state trajectory generated once with seed 7; the same 31 transitions are used for all compared branches.
leakage_controls: No parameters are fitted to the generated trajectory.
Filtering, open-loop, and persistence use identical actions and ground-truth positions.
Future observations are unavailable to the open-loop branch.

protocol.comparison_unit: three paired prediction branches on the same 31 transitions

randomness.rationale: Trajectory process and observation noise are stochastic, but the authored smoke freezes seed 7; one seed does not estimate seed variability.

protocol.action_space: scalar deterministic sinusoidal action schedule with an authored periodic offset
protocol.timing: one abstract transition per step; no wall-clock or controller-frequency claim
termination_conditions: Generate exactly 32 states and evaluate the following 31 transitions.
protocol.comparison_design: Compute filtering, prior-only open-loop, and persistence errors against the same latent positions without dropping steps.
protocol.selection_protocol: Observation and velocity gains, seed, and step count are fixed before evaluation; no result-dependent selection is allowed.
protocol.failure_definition: A run is invalid if it emits a non-finite metric, a transition count other than 31, or exposes a future observation to the open-loop branch.

metrics.name: filtering_rmse
metrics.aggregation: root mean squared filtered-position error over all 31 transitions

statistical_uncertainty.rationale: A single frozen seed is a regression fixture, not a repeated-seed estimate.

metrics.name: open_loop_rmse
metrics.aggregation: root mean squared prior-only position error over all 31 transitions

statistical_uncertainty.rationale: The fixed trajectory supports exact regression comparison only; it does not support a population interval.

metrics.name: persistence_rmse
metrics.aggregation: root mean squared previous-observation error over all 31 transitions

statistical_uncertainty.rationale: The baseline is evaluated on one frozen regression fixture rather than sampled deployments.

distribution_shift.rationale: No train/calibration/test population or uncertainty estimator exists in this data-flow smoke.

reporting.raw_predictions: Recompute from the seeded source; no large prediction artifact is emitted.
reporting.failure_artifacts: Invalid shape, action-conditioning, posterior-correction, and rollout-gap behavior is covered by chapter unit tests.
confounders: One authored dynamics process and one seed are used.
The model gains are hand-set rather than learned.
Filtering has observation access that prior-only rollout deliberately lacks.
reporting.missing_value_policy: All 31 transitions and all three metrics are required; no imputation, truncation, or failed-step filtering is allowed.

limitations: The model and trajectory are one-dimensional teaching constructions.
One seed cannot characterize stochastic variability or confidence intervals.
The benchmark does not measure closed-loop planning, neural training, GPU resources, or real-system validity.
